scope: 第五轮两臂小规模修正对照：固定旧权重起点、同预算，仅改变中心监督；不是正式方法优越性或独立测试结论
initialization: Only parent model tensors inherited; optimizer, scheduler, scaler, local cursor, and all random streams reset identically in both arms. This is a new warm-start experiment, not an extension of the old frozen plan.
augmentation: unchanged sample-seeded horizontal flip and RGB brightness [0.9,1.1]; shared seed/order across arms
schedule: new shared linear warmup and cosine decay; final checkpoint only

candidate_adoption.control_if_candidate_not_supported: Retain control only if it passes its engineering gate; otherwise neither arm is accepted.
candidate_adoption.interpretation: Budget/engineering decision only; not statistical significance or confirmed generalization. All arm and scene results retained.

checkpoint_selection: Fixed final local step1600 for both arms; parent1600 plus1600 additional updates, no validation-based checkpoint selection
validation_policy: All80 frames are development validation; evaluate only after final1600 new updates; historical four-scene subgroup kept for continuity, not blind testing
stop_rules: Stop on nonfinite state, invalid hashes, resume mismatch or low disk reserve
No threshold tuning or post-result budget extension
No automatic architecture, data or loss change beyond the two frozen arms
exclusions: No calibration or official test scenes
A failed candidate and failed control remain in the result archive
